notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Great Train Heist and casting the copy without paying its mana cost, and choosing to pay {2}{R} to select its first mode.
Resolve the copy of Great Train Heist, untapping all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase if it is currently a combat phase.
Repeat.
